Market today:
Mixed signals for tech. While Tesla got a boost from robotaxi news, broader AI sentiment faces "backlash" risks, and macro warnings about a debt crisis could add pressure. Energy policy for data centers is also a quiet headwind.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down over 50% and leveraged. SPAL, a brand-new, very volatile leveraged ETF, is also down significantly. SMH and QQQI are on TRIM status and nearing their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on your stops for SOXL, SPAL, SMH, and QQQI. Monitor AI sentiment and any further macro warnings that could impact growth stocks.

Bottom line:
Prioritize aggressive risk management and stop discipline, especially with your leveraged and concentrated book.
plays: Trim SOXL given its SELL status, -52.61% loss, and leveraged decay. Re-evaluate its default stop at 200.
SPAL is a new, leveraged position with a -42.39% loss. Review its stop at 21.38 carefully, as margin amplifies drops.
Consider a new buy on TSLA at entry 362.5-362.13 with a stop at 361.08, following its robotaxi launch news and scanner setup.
